adminNav.label: Payments
adminNav.description: Paid registration in Bitcoin, Monero and Solana

register.unlock: Your account is created now and unlocked once the payment is confirmed on the blockchain. Unpaid accounts are deleted after {days} days.
register.inviteFree: Registration with an invite code is free.

page.title: Activate your account
page.intro: Pay the registration fee in one of the accepted coins. Your account is unlocked automatically once the payment is confirmed.
page.unavailable: No payment method is available right now. Please contact the staff.
page.solanaReference: Use the wallet button below: the link carries a payment reference that identifies your account. A plain transfer to this address cannot be matched.
page.finalizedHint: Unlocked once the transaction is finalized (under a minute).
page.deadline: Without a payment, this account is deleted on {date}.
page.failed: Something went wrong, please try again

admin.title: Paid registration
admin.enabledDescription: New accounts stay locked until their payment is confirmed on-chain
admin.invitesPayDescription: Off: an invite code skips the payment
admin.pendingDaysDescription: Locked accounts that received nothing are deleted after this delay
admin.xpubHint: Native SegWit account key (BIP84). Never paste a private key. Raise the gap limit of your wallet so it sees every address.
admin.moneroReady: Wallet ready, scanned up to block {height}
admin.moneroMissing: Monero needs the bundled wallet service: re-run the installer and accept Monero, or set MONERO_WALLET_RPC_URL
admin.noPending: No account is waiting for payment
admin.moneroCreateIntro: The wallet service is running but has no wallet yet. Create a view-only wallet: it sees incoming payments and cannot spend. The view key is written to the wallet file only.
admin.moneroRestoreHeightHint: Block to start scanning from: the current height for a new wallet (scanning from 0 takes hours)
